title: Towards evaluations-based safety cases for AI scheming
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain any benchmarks that measure aspects of faith or religion. The focus is on AI safety, specifically evaluating an AI's capability for 'scheming', which includes deception, sabotage, and evading oversight.
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups; therefore, there are no findings related to religion.
